title: INSOMNIA - Sunseeker 86 Yacht
highlights: One of the last Sunseeker 86 Yachts built
Mooring included until end of April 2026
description:
INSOMNIA is one of the final Sunseeker 86 Yachts produced, built in 2019 as a 2020 model and located on mainland Spain. She features an extensive list of extras including a Jacuzzi, four en-suite cabins and full MCA compliance.

Twin MTU 12V 2000 M96L engines give a 22-knot cruise and 28 knots top speed. Delayed completion is available subject to offer, and part exchanges will be considered.
